home.title: Apparel brands built for how people actually get dressed.
home.copy: Milton Hosiery Industries designs and owns a portfolio of apparel brands out of Mumbai — now run by the second generation of the family that started it. We work with a small group of trusted manufacturing partners to bring each brand to retailers, distributors and institutional buyers across the country.
home.panelCopy: We design, name and market each brand ourselves. Production runs through a small set of contract manufacturing partners — we don't operate our own factory floor.
home.sectionCopy: Each brand has its own name, audience and product range. We keep them separate on purpose — a distributor stocking ANICY and a boutique stocking NICY are reaching very different customers.
home.retailersCopy: We supply through wholesale channels only — there's no direct-to-consumer store to compete with your shelf. Tell us which brand and volumes you're interested in and we'll get back to you with terms.
home.institutionalCopy: If you're buying in bulk for uniforms, hospitality or another institutional use, our team can work with you directly on specification and lead times.
home.ctaCopy: Send us a short note about your business and what you're looking for — we usually reply within a couple of working days.

about.title: About Milton Hosiery Industries
about.heritageCopy: Founded in 1973 by Mr Bankim Shroff, Milton Hosiery Industries began by manufacturing nylon trunks and men's vests. Over five decades, we have grown into a full-scale garment manufacturer while continuing to produce nylon trunks to this day.

brands.name: ANICY
brands.desc: Performance sportswear for men, crafted from 4-way Lycra fabric for comfort and freedom of movement.

brands.name: NICY
brands.desc: Palazzos and tops for girls and women, made from carefully selected imported fabrics.

brands.name: Avron
brands.desc: A new premium sportswear line, Engineered for flight.

about.manufacturingCopy: Based in Mumbai, our facility produces approximately 8,500 pieces every day:
about.qualityCopy: Our in-house quality control department inspects every piece, covering fabric, accessory placement, and washing, and every piece is individually packed.
partnerPoints: Wholesale and retail rates, with pricing based on quantity
No minimum order on standard products
Private label and customization available (minimum order 600 pieces)
Delivery within 5 days of order confirmation
about.visionCopy: We are building a brand for rural India: one that delivers quality and creativity at a price that lets customers buy with confidence.
about.customersCopy: We proudly serve wholesalers and retailers across the Pune and Ahmednagar districts of Maharashtra, including many tier 2 and tier 3 cities and towns.
